# Spar 0.6.11

This patch release makes challenge creation something you can watch. The
"Build challenge" row now grows a live tree of what is happening: the design
being drafted file by file, the fit reviewer's verdict streaming in, revisions
and repairs rewriting files in place, and every sandbox validation run with its
own pass or catch count. Stages fold to one line as soon as the next one starts,
and a finished build reads as a short column of verdicts. The reference
solution, hidden tests and known-incorrect solution are redacted in the agent
worker, so they are never sent to the UI or stored.

Also in this release:

- A fit reviewer checks each drafted challenge against your recent work before
  it is validated, and asks for a revision when it would only repeat something
  you have already practised.
- The model picker reads Pi's live model catalog, so newly published models and
  their current limits show up without waiting for an app update.
- A usage panel in Settings shows where the agent's tokens went.
- Answered agent questions stay visible in the thread after the work folds.
- Pi packages updated to 0.87.1. Development LangSmith traces are tagged and
  exported directly.
